{{For|other uses of [[Bunny (Disambiguation)|Bunny]]|[[Sentry (Disambiguation)|Sentry]]}} {{InteractableInfobox |image-static = BunnySentry.png |image-dynamic = BunnySentryDynamic.png |type = Offensive |appearance = [[Bathroom Approach]] |effects = Deals 300 damage to enemies
Prevents [[Nerd Ducky]] from damaging the base with its ''Material Destruction'' ability |cost = {{Money|75,000}}Next '''Bunny Sentry''' has its cost increased by {{Money|50,000}} after one is bought. }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Bunny Sentry''' is an interactable turret that appears in [[Bathroom Approach]] as part of the [[Ducky Revenge Event]] and its rerun in the [[Spring Frenzy Battle Pass]]. The '''Bunny Sentry''' now deals 300 damage and 0.275 second firerate1,090.91 in actual DPS or 1,200 in implied DPS. in its 25 range. It has both flying and hidden detections, and also always targets the strongest enemy. It costs {{Money|75,000}} to build, with each additional '''Bunny Sentry''' requiring {{Money|50,000}} more to build. On the final wave of the Hard difficulty, the [[Nerd Ducky]] can use its ''Material Destruction'' ability, which deals damage to the base health, stuns towers and deals damage to units. If a '''Bunny Sentry''' was on the map, it will launch into [[Nerd Ducky]], stunning it and preventing it from affecting towers, units or base health. The '''Bunny Sentry''' has no impact on the [[Nerd Ducky]]'s health or speed. ==Appearance== The '''Bunny Sentry''' is a sentry with a rabbit head with a spring-loaded mechanism and dual carrot autocannons mounted on each side. Around the '''Bunny Sentry''' it stands on a green puzzle platform. ==Update History== *'''16 April 2025''' - [[v1.61.0]] **'''Bunny Sentry''' added. *'''28 May 2025''' - [[v1.65.0]] **'''Bunny Sentry''' removed. *'''3 April 2026''' - [[v1.88.0]] **'''Bunny Sentry''' re-added. **Damage increased from 5 to 300. **Firerate increased from 0.175 to 0.275. **Base cost increased from {{Money|5,000}} to {{Money|75,000}}. **Cost increase per '''Bunny Sentry''' increased from {{Money|2,500}} to {{Money|50,000}}. **Targeting changed from ''First Enemy'' to ''Strongest''. ==Notes== {{InteractableNavBox}}
